description:
Use this when you need to author text into a kernelCAD script before the last top-level return. One authoring path, selected by `mode`:
- 'sketch' — insert a sketch.text(...) call. The emitted sketch is chainable: pair with subsequent .extrude(...) / cut(...) edits to land an engraved or raised text feature.
- 'emboss' — insert a `<shape>.embossText({...})` chained call onto an existing Shape `target`. Use for engraved brand text on faces (Ray-Ban temple, CE mark, model number). `depth > 0` raises text out of the face; `depth < 0` engraves text into the face. Lowers via replicad drawText → sketchOnFace → extrude → fuse|cut.
Default font is the runtime-bundled Liberation Sans. Side-effect-free; returns the modified code plus diagnostics from re-evaluating. Each mode fails closed on its own missing required params.

align.description: mode:'sketch' — horizontal alignment relative to position (default left); mode:'emboss' — relative to the UV anchor (default center).

anchorU.description: mode:'emboss' — U anchor in [0, 1] face-local (0=umin, 0.5=centre, 1=umax). Default 0.5.

anchorV.description: mode:'emboss' — V anchor in [0, 1] face-local. Default 0.5.

depth.description: mode:'emboss' — signed extrusion depth in mm: positive emboss out, negative engrave in. Must be non-zero.

face.description: mode:'emboss' — target face — canonical name ('top'/'bottom'/'left'/'right'/'front'/'back') or label.

font.description: mode:'sketch' — optional logical font name or .ttf file path; defaults to bundled Liberation Sans.

fontFamily.description: mode:'emboss' — optional logical font name or .ttf file path; defaults to bundled Liberation Sans.

position.description: mode:'sketch' — [x, y] anchor in mm. Default [0, 0].

rotation.description: mode:'sketch' — CCW rotation in degrees around position (default 0); mode:'emboss' — CCW rotation in the face tangent plane (default 0).

scaleMode.description: mode:'emboss' — Drawing.sketchOnFace scaling mode. Default original.

size.description: mode:'sketch'|'emboss' — glyph cap height in mm (positive finite).

target.description: mode:'emboss' — variable name of the Shape to chain onto (inserted verbatim).

name: add_text

binding_name.description: JS const name bound to the new construct (when one was created).

diagnostics.description: Diagnostics from re-evaluating the modified source.

error.description: Failure message (present when ok is false).

new_code.description: Modified .kcad.ts source (present on success). Caller persists it.

ok.description: Whether the edit applied and re-evaluated cleanly.

title: Add Text
